value: definite article le is fixed
passé composé with avoir : elle a pris le métro

evidence.notes: Fixed collocation with the definite article; prendre takes avoir in the passé composé. Confidence high.

value: definite article le is fixed
possessive variant : prendre son petit déjeuner

evidence.notes: Usage note states prendre is the standard verb with meals; the possessive variant is listed as an alias. Confidence high.

value: possessive agrees with the subject : prendre sa retraite / prendre leur retraite
passé composé with avoir : a pris sa retraite

evidence.notes: Usage note states the possessive agrees with the subject; source exercise 'Ils (prendre) leur retraite' and 'a-t-il pris sa retraite?' show both. Confidence high.

value: possessive agrees with the owner, not the addressee : ne prends pas ma voiture
negative imperative : ne prends pas ma voiture

evidence.notes: Source example 'Ne prends pas ma voiture!' shows the possessive and the negative imperative. Confidence high.

indefinite article un is fixed

value: indefinite article un is fixed
imperative : prends un café avant de partir

value: indefinite article une is fixed
